course.title: ConfigKit Learning Materials
course.description: Introduction to mobile configuration profiles using ConfigKit, including Wi-Fi, DNS, and web clip profiles.

prerequisites.item: Access to a web browser and the ConfigKit website.
Follow your teacher's instructions for any device or account setup.

learningObjectives.objective: Explain what a mobile configuration profile is and what it can configure.
Identify the purpose of Wi-Fi, DNS, and web clip profile settings.
Create a practice configuration profile using teacher-approved example values.
Review profile settings and consider privacy and security before installation.

module.title: Getting started with ConfigKit
module.summary: Explore the ConfigKit website and learn the purpose of its profile-generation tools.
module.activity: Visit the website and identify the available profile types.

module.title: Wi-Fi profiles
module.summary: Learn how a Wi-Fi profile can store network connection settings.
module.activity: Create a sample Wi-Fi profile with fictional classroom values. Do not use or submit a personal network password.

module.title: DNS profiles
module.summary: Understand the role of DNS in translating domain names into network addresses.
module.activity: Describe what a DNS setting changes and record the example values supplied by your teacher.

module.title: Web clip profiles
module.summary: Learn how a web clip can provide a home-screen shortcut to a website.
module.activity: Plan a web clip for a teacher-approved learning website.

module.title: Review, privacy, and safety
module.summary: Check generated settings before installing or sharing a configuration profile.
module.activity: Use the safety checklist below to review a sample profile before use.

safetyChecklist.item: Use fictional or teacher-approved values for classroom practice.
Never include personal passwords, private network credentials, or sensitive student information.
Read and understand a profile before installing it.
Only install profiles on devices you own or are authorised to manage.
Ask your teacher or device administrator if a setting is unclear.

assessment.task: Explain the purpose of a mobile configuration profile in your own words.
Compare the purposes of Wi-Fi, DNS, and web clip profiles.
Identify at least three safety checks to complete before installing a profile.

teacherNotes.note: Adapt activities and example values to the class level and device-management policy.
This file is a starter learning resource. Add lesson-specific worksheets, links, and due dates as needed.
